text: きいた　こと　ないや

structure.jp: きいた　こと　ないや

patterns.name: 〜たことがない
patterns.span: きいた　こと　ない
patterns.explanation: Past verb + ことがない means 'have never done'; が is dropped here in casual speech. きいた こと ない = 'I've never heard of it'.

patterns.name: 〜や (to oneself)
patterns.explanation: や at the end is a light, casual remark, half to oneself, here said by a child. ないや = 'nope, haven't'.
